user.title: Connect to Drink Morning Cloud
user.description: Enter the email and password for your Morning mobile application account to discover your coffee machine.

select_machine.description: Multiple machines were discovered on your account. Choose which ones to add to Home Assistant:

error.no_machine_selected: You must select at least one machine to continue.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Please check Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Morning account is already configured.

init.title: Morning Coffee Machine Options
init.description: Configure the telemetry polling interval for your Morning machine(s).

set_standby_timeout.name: Set Standby Timeout
set_standby_timeout.description: Updates the auto-sleep energy saving standby timeout on the Morning machine.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Auto-sleep standby timer duration in seconds (between 300 and 7200).

reset_machine.name: Reset Machine
reset_machine.description: Triggers a software reset on the Morning Coffee Machine.

check_updates.name: Check Updates
check_updates.description: Checks the Morning cloud backend for available firmware updates.
